**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (confidence 0.86).**

Investigation summary:
- **Sections searched:** all 10 sections plus the tail (Sections 26–30). No transition, exit, data-return/export or deletion-timing language exists.
- **Section 13 (p0078)** only puts the burden on *us* — Client must arrange a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days — and confirms Client retains ownership of domains and Client Content. Ownership without a return/export mechanic gives us nothing usable on exit.
- **Section 14 (p0079)** merely continues Hosting and Support Services to the end of the following month after our termination notice; that is a service wind-down, not transition assistance, and carries no data obligations.
- **Section 10 (Confidentiality)** contains no return-or-destroy obligation, so the planner's suspected analogue does not exist.

Because there is no data return at all, the position sits in walk-away territory. I inserted one short clause (new Section 14a, inside the surviving Sections 5–30 range) at the **preferred** level: up to six months' assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of Client Content and other Client data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion **after** return. All six preferred elements are carried by that single insertion; the 90-day/30-day fallback is offered in the comment.
